text:
very bearish on all this step counting

“I took 12,367 steps today"

measuring everything in steps instead of miles/km

was there an issue with those or something, I missed it

this reeks of mf’s wanting credit for walking down the hall to take a dump

more dork behavior

whoops and oura rings and sleep scores and stravas

u tell someone to walk 4-5 miles a day and they ask “how many steps is that"

idk dude, I don’t know wtf your steps look like compared to mine

do your balls clank when you walk

if not, our steps may not be directly comparable

have u thought about just walking into the sea and leaving it all behind, I bet u could hit 15,000 steps 

non-GAAP-ass movement measures and shit

lord have mercy
